policy: A collection may satisfy the usable-avatar requirement with one exhaustive supported representation lane: structurally valid VRM, rigged GLB, or evidence-backed rigged FBX. Legacy VRM not_shipped states do not terminally resolve the broader avatar inventory. Explicitly catalog-bound OpenPage VRM/GLB discoveries are merged as candidates only and cannot make an inventory exhaustive without separate coverage evidence.

Moralis confirms the token metadata publishes the GLB URL directly without authentication.
